evidence_items.finding: four commercial cleaning contracts have been cancelled this year due to client complaints about inconsistent service standards — representing approximately $180,000 in lost annual contract value
evidence_items.rationale: Contract cancellations attributed to quality inconsistency is the primary failure signal. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: two of the four cancelled contracts specifically cited a noticeable drop in standard when a different cleaning team was assigned to the site
evidence_items.rationale: Team-assignment-correlated quality complaints point to between-team variation as the failure mechanism. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: no quality inspection or checklist process exists — cleaning teams self-certify completion and client feedback is handled informally with no written record kept
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of quality assurance infrastructure is the structural cause of inconsistency. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: new contract wins have kept total revenue approximately flat, masking the underlying rate of contract departure
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue stability masking contract churn is a diagnostic blind-spot signal. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: commercial cleaning contractor; annual revenue $820K; 15 cleaners; four contracts lost this year; average contract value $45,000; owner personally audits one to two sites per week; no written complaint records maintained
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary from facts_known_to_owner. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): total revenue has remained approximately stable due to new contract wins replacing cancelled contracts
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue stability is a misleading signal — it conceals the contract churn rate.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): several long-standing clients have provided positive feedback and the owner's own site audits pass without issue
evidence_items.rationale: Positive feedback from retained clients and the owner's personal audit sites are misleading signals — they are not representative of the sites where complaints occurred.

validation_notes: HOL-09-001 is a between-team quality inconsistency contract churn case. All findings derived from input_packet. No must_identify vocabulary used.
